decision.explanation: The query asks for the genre of the film 'Inner Sanctum'. The source documents present conflicting claims regarding the genre of the 1948 film 'Inner Sanctum': Document 1 (D1S1) and Document 2 (D2S2) classify it as 'film noir', while Document 3 (D3S1) and Document 4 (D4S3) classify it as 'romantic comedy'. Additionally, Document 5 (D5S3-D5S4) describes a 1991 film titled 'Inner Sanctum' as an 'erotic thriller'. Per the instruction to keep supported alternate referents and distinct valid namesakes rather than selecting a single winner, all three genres found in the text are included as valid answers corresponding to the specific film instances described.
